reply.emotion: waiting at a busy street corner, watching for the headlights to appear
notes: In Mexico and many other Spanish-speaking countries, 'camión' is the everyday word for a city bus, whereas in Spain it is more commonly used for a large freight truck.

senses.definition: Vehículo grande para transportar a muchos pasajeros por la ciudad.

examples.text: Esperamos el camión en la esquina.
examples.translation: We wait for the bus at the corner.
examples.emotion: impatient and a little tired from standing so long

senses.definition: Vehículo grande y pesado con cuatro o más ruedas para transportar mercancía.

examples.text: El camión transporta cajas pesadas por la carretera.
examples.translation: The truck transports heavy boxes along the highway.
examples.emotion: observing something massive rolling past on the highway
